project_type: Full-stack monorepo: Python FastAPI backend, React frontend, Cloudflare Worker edge proxy
build_system: pip + requirements.txt for backend, pnpm + wrangler for edge, vite for frontend
test_framework: vitest for edge, pytest for backend (though no tests directory found)
test_command: cd apps/edge && npx tsc --noEmit (type-check only, no test infrastructure set up)
verification_instructions: 1. Run TypeScript type-check for edge: cd apps/edge && npx tsc --noEmit. 2. Run Python syntax check for backend: python -m py_compile on changed files. 3. Verify no import errors in backend files.
setup_instructions: 1. cd apps/edge && pnpm install. 2. cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt (large, skip if only doing type-checks)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full access. Python 3.11, Node 22, pnpm available.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns. Maintain backward compatibility. Do not modify AI routing logic.
key_patterns: Edge worker: middleware pattern in src/middleware/, routes in src/routes/. Backend: APIRouter pattern in app/api/v1/, models in app/models/, services in app/services/. MongoDB access via beanie ODM (Chat model) or raw motor client (get_mongo_client). Auth uses get_current_user / get_current_user_optional dependencies. Config via pydantic Settings in app/config.py.
directory_structure: apps/edge/src/ - Cloudflare Worker (index.ts entry, middleware/, routes/). apps/backend/app/ - FastAPI (api/v1/ routers, models/, services/, db/, config.py, main.py). apps/frontend/src/ - React SPA.
